ideal: Use free and included allowances before anything that bills, read their use the same day, and never idle free capacity in a lane over budget.

sources.title: REST API endpoints for billing usage

quality: No free capacity sits idle in a lane over budget, no useful free allowance is left unclaimed, and each allowance stays under its limit.
speed: Every claimed allowance's use is read, from limits re-read within a week.
consumption: The plan's included Actions allowance stays under its limit.
